data.title: Binance Introduces the BNB Pioneer Burn Program, Adjusts BNB Token Burn Mechanics
data.body: {"node":"root","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Fellow Binancians,"}]}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","attr":{"style":"text-align:justify;"},"child":[{"node":"text","text":"Binance is introducing the BNB Pioneer Burn Program, a new initiative that aims to help eligible users who lose tokens as part of mistakes they made while trying out the newly-launched Binance Smart Chain. Under the BNB Pioneer Burn Program, Binance will cover users’ losses for accepted cases and count the lost tokens under our quarterly BNB token burn activities instead."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","attr":{"style":"text-align:justify;"},"child":[{"node":"text","text":"As a result of this program, we are making adjustments to mechanics of the quarterly BNB token burn. We will discuss this further below."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","attr":{"style":"text-align:justify;"},"child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Eligibility for the BNB Pioneer Burn Program "}]}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","attr":{"style":"text-align:justify;"},"child":[{"node":"text","text":"Binance.com will help users who lose their assets in the following cases below:"}]},{"node":"element","tag":"ul","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"li","child":[{"node":"text","text":"The lost tokens are either BNB, “wrapped” tokens (e.g. WBNB), or “pegged” tokens (e.g. BTCB) supported via the Binance “Token Canal” Project;"}]},{"node":"element","tag":"li","child":[{"node":"text","text":"The lost tokens are transferred to BEP20 contract addresses that are more than 1,000 USD, but is less than the projected BNB burn amount in the upcoming quarter."}]}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","attr":{"style":"text-align:justify;"},"child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Mechanics for the BNB Pioneer Burn This extra amount will not be counted as part of increased total supply."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"li","child":[{"node":"text","text":"For BNB, Binance will send BNB to the originating address of the case (with fees deducted). The number will be booked and counted as part of the total BNB burned in the next quarterly burn."}]}]}]}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","attr":{"style":"text-align:justify;"},"child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Adjustments for the BNB Quarterly Token Burn "}]}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","attr":{"style":"text-align:justify;"},"child":[{"node":"text","text":"Effective on the third quarter of 2020 (July 1 to September 30), this will be the new calculation for the BNB Quarterly Token Burn:"}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","attr":{"style":"text-align:justify;"},"child":[{"node":"text","text":"Actual BNB Quarterly Token Burn = Original BNB Token Burn Amount - Amount of BNB Distributed Through the BNB Pioneer Burn Program"}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","attr":{"style":"text-align:justify;"},"child":[{"node":"text","text":"To clarify, we are not deviating from the original token burn amounts planned for the upcoming quarters.
